title: Poc Tech Cgm
body:
Greetings to all, 

I am greatful of your work, and how dedicate you are on xdrip and to all of us. We have used for one week as a trial the Poc Tech Cgm and it looks great since it is like dexcom. I am wondering if are you planning to include this Cgm solution at the near future. Is there any help i might provide to you so we can have xdrip at the next update for Poc Tech? 
Their site is http://www.poctechcorp.com/en/contents/268/5682.html

Thanks Dimitris

comments.body:
Hello Dimitris,

we are in contact with them and do have a proof-of-concept to include PocTech data off their app.
Unfortunately their app does not run in the background yet. This means their alarms don't work at night and also xDrip and AndroidAPS can't get the data.
I hope this will be resolved soon.

Drop me a message at adrian@androidaps.org if you want to be an early tester.

cheers,
Adrian

Hey there,
Has anyone succeeded in connecting POCTech with xDrip?
Is there any update to this?
